articles.title: Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.22161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear. articles.title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.22277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. articles.title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.22353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. articles.title: Social Influence and the Allocation of Scientific Attention in AI Populations

articles.title: Goal-driven Variant Categorization
articles.summary: arXiv:2609.22475v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Process discovery rarely yields a single coherent process structure. For analysis, a common step is to cluster process variants based on structural similarity and then assign business meaning to the resulting groups.
